correctness.rationale: The RESULT.md exact 4x9 valuation matrix yields witness bundles A1={x,b}, A2={y}, A3={c,d,p,q}, A4={a,e}, utility vector (4K,3K,2K+3,2K), and exact maximum-other-bundle-after-single-deletion table. Agent 3 against agent 1 achieves equality, all twelve ratios obey alpha=(2K+3)/(3K) for K>=6. Welfare maximum is 11K+4, the witness is 11K+3, and a dominating allocation would maximize each good individually: agent 1 must own x, then agent 3 all of c,d,e, agent 2 y, leaving agent 4 no more than K+2<2K; contradiction. The upper bound for strictly greater alpha is imported from Theorem 2 of arXiv:2610.29201v1. Independently checked rational ratios for K=6,7,8,12 and exhaustive 4^9 candidate dominators for K=6; finite checks are corroboration.
